subrequirements.verification: Devign-derived FFmpeg/QEMU C functions; target bool label0/1; provider C-UDA declaration verified locally. This is not complete rights clearance for upstream code.

subrequirements.criterion: Actual sizes, class counts and official partitions
subrequirements.verification: Raw row/class counts independently read; cleaned development sizes/indexes matched. No new random split.
Pinned URLs/checksums and download commands exist. Shared projects/commits, noisy labels, near-clones and external generalization are disclosed.
Recorded raw missing fields/invalid labels are zero; invalid development records have explicit reasons; invalid test labels halt evaluation.
4029 training /463 validation structural parse failures produce NaN in eight features; saved training medians reproduced and transformed training data finite.
Exactly reproduced all113 removals,54 contradictory development groups and zero normalized cross-split overlaps; near-clone/shared-commit dependence remains.
All11 model inputs are numerical. project,commit_id,id,target and names are excluded; no categorical predictor requires encoding. Bool target→0/1 is label conversion.
LR StandardScaler mean/scale reproduce imputed training rows; code fits preprocessing only on X_train.
RF/HGB use numerical split thresholds and do not require standard scaling. Median imputation remains in both pipelines.
Official memberships retained, seed42, validation-only selection, test labels omitted from development reads. Final test evaluation guard recorded once.
Shared ordered11 float64 features/parser/schema and saved preprocessing checked; API values match actual pipeline scores. Exact .5 class tie fixed to recorded >=.5 rule.

subrequirements.criterion: Dataset overview, class balance and missing/duplicate EDA
subrequirements.verification: Real development data and raw integrity statistics; test labels are not development EDA inputs.
Saved figures, labels and underlying summary inspected; three original plots visually opened. Pairwise correlations use observed training values.
Size/class medians, skew, parse coverage and feature correlation observations supported; no causality/feature-attribution claim.

subrequirements.criterion: Train two to four appropriate models
subrequirements.verification: Exactly three candidates with real pipelines, fit markers, parameter records and train/validation metrics; checkpoint hashes verified.
Each candidate tested on untouched-by-fit validation rows using accuracy,precision,recall,F1,AUC and confusion matrices. No retuning here.

subrequirements.criterion: Literal final-test metrics for each model
subrequirements.verification: Only selected RF evaluated on final test. Ask instructor whether validation evaluation for all candidates meets train-and-test-each wording. Do not invent or rerun missing final-test results.
Seed42, recorded versions/checksums/hyperparameters, no fit warnings, no search/refit-on-validation; unchanged implementation hashes verified.

subrequirements.criterion: Compare appropriate metrics without mixing splits
subrequirements.verification: All candidate validation metrics tabulated; RF held-out results separated. Saved confusion-derived arithmetic verified; AUC not recomputed from holdout scores.
